capabilities: Render Bullet Journal styled checkboxes in reading mode
Change bullet type from a right-click context menu
Change the current line's bullet type with commands and hotkeys
Add custom signifiers like ! and ? to the start of bullets
extras: README lists known issues: copying custom checkboxes from reading mode loses the bullet type, and undo behaves unexpectedly when changing types from the right-click menu.
intentEvidence: Alternate checkbox types for Obsidian to support Bullet Journal bullets.
problem: Obsidian's task lists only support standard checkboxes, so Bullet Journal bullet types like migrated, scheduled, or irrelevant tasks have to be tracked as plain text.
summary: Bullet Journal checkbox plugin that renders alternate checkbox types (tasks, events, migrations) and lets you change bullet types via menu, commands, and hotkeys.
